tables in app/schema.sql: assets / engagements / approvals / proofs.
The asset values here are the ONLY source of the report's affected-asset
list; the claim text in verdicts.json deliberately names a DIFFERENT address
so tests/report.test.mjs can prove the ledger wins over prose.
This fixture is not a hash-chained ledger snapshot; ledger-export.test.mjs
builds its own chain and verifies it for real.
